findings.oracle: Real live chat() against the provider with prompt "Respond with one word: hello"; independent oracle = the fixed greeting-token set (hello/hi/hey/greetings/...) plus a readable-character ratio; asserts role==assistant, a greeting token is present, and readable_ratio>=0.6 (gibberish fails).

Real live chat_stream() with "Say hello briefly."; oracle = greeting-token set + readable ratio over the reassembled text; asserts every chunk is str, reassembled text is non-empty, contains a greeting token, and readable_ratio>=0.6 (random chunks fail).

Real live chat() with tools and a prompt naming the Windows notepad.exe path; oracle = that exact requested path; asserts function_name==binary.get_file_size, tool_name==binary, and arguments[path] normalizes to end with notepad.exe and contain windows (empty/garbage args fail).

Real live chat() over a 4-turn history (name=Archimedes, field=binary analysis) asking name+work; oracle = the seeded facts; asserts content contains "archimedes" AND ("binary" or "analysis") -- AND not OR, so ignoring context fails.

Real live chat() asking for a long essay with max_tokens=32; oracle = token-to-word ratio bound; asserts non-empty content and <=45 words, tight enough that ignoring max_tokens (dozens/hundreds of words) fails.

Real live list_models(); oracle = vendor naming convention + configured model constant + realistic context window; asserts every id contains the vendor substring, name non-empty, provider label matches, context_window>=4000, bool capability flags, and the configured model id is present (fabricated records fail).

Real live chat() of "What is 2 + 2?" across every credentialed provider; oracle = the known answer 4; asserts each response word-matches  4  or  four  (wrong/junk answers fail).

Adds a real error path: empty tools=[] must still yield an assistant turn, and a malformed ToolChoice(SPECIFIC, function_name="") with real tools must raise ProviderError; asserts both the happy turn and the typed rejection (silent malformed send fails).
Real live chat_stream() across providers; oracle = readable-character ratio; asserts >=1 chunk, reassembled text non-empty, and readable_ratio>=0.6 (binary/control-noise chunks fail).

Real live chat() with model "claude-nonexistent-999"; oracle = HTTP client-rejection status; asserts the ProviderError chain carries a 4xx status (400/401/402/403/404/422/429), distinguishing an API model rejection from a bare transport/auth fault.
Real live chat() with model "gpt-nonexistent-999"; oracle = 4xx status + error text; asserts the chain has a client-rejection status AND the message says "model" and "does not exist"/"not found".

Real connect() to a non-routable endpoint 10.255.255.1:9 with timeout=2.0; oracle = deterministic transport timeout; asserts a ProviderError whose chain names "timeout"/"timed out" and surfaces in <20s (no broad multi-type swallow).
